description: A MIDI clock running at 24 pulses per quarter note, generating its own tempo or following an analogue or MIDI clock, with analogue and vMIDI outputs

params.text: Sends the clock back to the start of the count, pulses RESET OUT, and sends a song position of zero out of MIDI OUT
Starts the clock if it is stopped and stops it if it is running, sending the matching MIDI start, continue or stop message

inputs.text: Runs and stops the clock; how the voltage here is read is set by Run In Mode on the menu, and the lamp beside the jack tracks the voltage
A rising edge above 1V stops the clock, whatever the RUN IN jack is doing
Takes an analogue clock at 24 pulses per quarter note, counting a tick on each rising edge above 1V; for 2 seconds after each edge it overrides the clock arriving at MIDI IN
A rising edge above 1V resets the clock count and pulses RESET OUT, and for 2 seconds afterwards it overrides the clock arriving at MIDI IN
Takes a vMIDI stream and follows its timing ticks, start, continue and stop; a recent edge on CLOCK IN or RESET IN takes precedence over it

outputs.text: Carries timing ticks at 24 per quarter note the whole time, running or stopped, with start, continue, stop and song position sent as they happen
A 4ms pulse to 10V on every tick that survives the output divider, and only while the clock is running
A 4ms pulse to 10V whenever the clock count is reset, from the button, the RESET IN jack or a MIDI start

notes: the tempo, the run state, the clock source, the output divider and the autostart setting are all on the black display, and none of them can be clicked for help
scroll over the large number on the display to change the tempo a beat per minute at a time, 30 to 300; hold shift while scrolling to move it by 0.1, and click the number to tap a tempo
click the word INT or EXT on the display to switch between the module's own tempo and following an incoming clock; EXT is drawn cyan while it is locked and red while it is not
click the word RUN or STOP on the display to start and stop the clock
scroll over the d:1/ reading on the display to divide the CLOCK OUT jack, from 1/1, which is every tick, down to 1/24, which is one pulse per quarter note
click the word MAN or AUTO on the display to switch autostart; with AUTO showing, the clock starts on its own a fraction of a second after a patch is loaded
menu: Run In Mode: Momentary, Run, Toggle — sets how the RUN IN jack is read; Momentary runs while it is high, Run starts on a high but never stops, Toggle flips the run state on each rising edge
